verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native bulk-operation feature. Bulk work across many repositories, issues or other items would have to be scripted by the user through Gitea's API and webhooks, the official `tea` CLI, or the official MCP server. Missing for 10: any documented native bulk-action capability (e.g. mass issue or label edits, multi-repo operations), batch API endpoints, hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404).
